injection_details.method: Self-injection / local process injection: decrypt 48-byte shellcode, find an executable section or 0xCC/0x00 code cave in the current image, VirtualProtectEx(PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE=0x40), WriteProcessMemory, VirtualProtectEx(PAGE_EXECUTE_READ=0x20), then CreateRemoteThread; if CreateRemoteThread fails, NtCreateThreadEx is resolved dynamically from ntdll.dll (LoadLibraryA+GetProcAddress) and used instead; WaitForSingleObject(5000ms) + CloseHandle
injection_details.target_process: Itself (current process) - handle obtained via GetCurrentProcess()
injection_details.target_discovery: Own image base via GetModuleHandleA(NULL); PE section headers parsed to find IMAGE_SCN_MEM_EXECUTE section (VirtualAddress+base = 0x140001000 .text) or a run of >=48 0xCC/0x00 padding bytes used as a code cave
injection_details.payload_write: WriteProcessMemory(current_process, section_ptr, decoded_payload, 0x30) into its own executable section
injection_details.payload_source: Encrypted blob in .data at VA 0x140003000, XOR-decoded at runtime

encryption_details.algorithm: Layer 1 (effective): repeating-key XOR, 48-byte payload (VA 0x140003000) XORed byte-wise with key[i mod 12]. Layer 2 (decoy/dead-code): custom AES-S-box byte-substitution, 10 rounds: out[j] = AES_SBOX[in[j]] ^ key[j] ^ (27*round), applied to a separate 16-byte blob (VA 0x140003030); result is discarded (never used)
encryption_details.key: XOR key (12 bytes, raw): c3 7a 9f 2e 55 8b 1d 6c e4 31 a8 4f ; S-box routine key (16 bytes, ASCII): 4xdm1n_S3cr3t!!!
encryption_details.key_storage: Hardcoded in .rdata: XOR key at VA 0x140004000 (12 bytes, not ASCII), S-box routine key at VA 0x140004120 (plaintext string), AES S-box table (256 bytes) at VA 0x140004020

anti_analysis: anti_vm_cpuid: CPUID leaf 1, tests ECX bit 31 (hypervisor-present bit); if set, Sleep(30000) and skips payload injection
obfuscation: embedded shellcode payload XOR-encrypted with a 12-byte key
obfuscation/decoy: AES S-box substitution routine (10 rounds) with key '4xdm1n_S3cr3t!!!' performing dead computation on an unused buffer
timing/sandbox evasion: Sleep(30000) on suspected VM, Sleep(1000) after injection, WaitForSingleObject(5000)
